top_offers.title: Head of Engineering
top_offers.why: Only one offer cleared the quality bar today, so this C-grade fills the slot: Head of Engineering at Frida, an established Zurich-area consumer brand, matches Magino's leadership-track target and Switzerland location preference. Listing details are thin (behind Wellfound's access wall) and the parenting-products mission is a stretch from his AI-first, impact-driven preference.
